company.name: Blenheim
company.market_position: Independent Amsterdam law firm (~24 lawyers) at Westerdoksdijk; member of Lawyers Associated Worldwide. Strong in real estate, construction and public administration.
company.commercial_proposition: Full-service legal: real estate & construction law, permits/Bibob, commercial contracts, litigation, corporate advisory.
company.needs: Clients with real-estate, construction, permits or commercial-contract matters; referral relationships with developers and corporates.
company.ideal_counterpart: Real-estate developers, construction & fit-out firms, hospitality operators and corporates needing legal counsel.

enrichment.notes: Teun Blom is partner in Real Estate & Public Administration. High corporate-access value; natural match with real-estate developers and fit-out firms (e.g. E=MC2) in this participant pool.

company.name: Event Culinair BV
company.market_position: Premium concept-catering company (25+ yrs) serving unique Amsterdam venues; partner of Unique Venues of Amsterdam. Own production kitchen and chef pool.
company.commercial_proposition: High-end event catering: concept catering, conferences, sit-down/walking dinners, cocktail parties at unique locations.
company.needs: Event bookings; access to corporate event organizers, venues and companies hosting events.
company.ideal_counterpart: Corporate event planners, event agencies, venues, hospitality operators and member companies running events (incl. MeerBusiness events).

enrichment.notes: Erik Dercksen is adviser/ambassador (company owned by his wife Corina); 25 yrs in Amsterdam events. Strong hospitality-opportunity node for the event/venue cluster.
